entities.summary: Viva Seifert is a British independent musician, actress and former gymnast who sings and performs on the drums, keyboards and piano. She is a founding member of the post-rock band Bikini Atoll, the blues rock duo Joe Gideon & the Shark, and the electronica duo Lunge.
